evals.prompt: All my deps are probably stale. Update the NuGet packages, dotnet tools, and the hook tool pins in this repo. Show me what you'd run and what files would change.
evals.expected_output: Structured plan/execution covering dotnet-outdated for NuGet, dotnet tool update for local tools, bumping ActionlintVersion/GitleaksVersion in .githooks/pins.ps1 with `just doctor`, and a debug build validation. Identifies Directory.Packages.props as the central NuGet version file. Does not touch app release version fields.

assertions.name: mentions dotnet-outdated
assertions.description: Response includes the dotnet-outdated command for NuGet package updates

assertions.name: mentions hook tool pins
assertions.description: Response points at the pinned actionlint/gitleaks versions in .githooks/pins.ps1 (no pre-commit framework, which the repo no longer uses)

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) - not bare 'dotnet tool update' which would target the global manifest

assertions.name: covers all dep types
assertions.description: Response addresses NuGet packages, dotnet tools, AND the hook tool pins - not just one or two

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing <Version>, <AssemblyVersion>, <FileVersion>, or Identity Version

assertions.name: includes build validation
assertions.description: Response includes a dotnet build command to validate after updating

evals.prompt: The actionlint and gitleaks pins and my dotnet tool versions are probably stale. Can you update them? Also bump any outdated NuGet packages while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: Correct per-tool dotnet tool update commands, the .githooks/pins.ps1 constants to bump with `just doctor` to confirm the installed binaries, dotnet-outdated for NuGet, and a validation build. Correctly identifies Directory.Packages.props as the central version file.

assertions.name: mentions hook tool pins
assertions.description: Response points at ActionlintVersion/GitleaksVersion in .githooks/pins.ps1 and verifies with `just doctor`

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) - not bare 'dotnet tool update' which targets the global manifest

assertions.name: references Directory.Packages.props
assertions.description: Response mentions Directory.Packages.props as the central NuGet version file

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing <Version>, <AssemblyVersion>, <FileVersion>, or Identity Version

evals.prompt: Time to refresh dependencies before the next release. I want everything updated - NuGet, the actionlint/gitleaks pins, and the local dotnet tools. What's the right order and what commands do I run?
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step ordered workflow: dotnet-outdated first, then dotnet tool update for each tool, then the pins in .githooks/pins.ps1 with `just doctor` and `just check`, then validation build. Notes that SDK BuildTools bump may also require TargetFramework/MaxVersionTested updates.

assertions.name: correct step ordering
assertions.description: NuGet update comes before or alongside tools/hooks - not after a build

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) - not bare 'dotnet tool update' which targets the global manifest

assertions.name: mentions hook tool pins
assertions.description: Response points at the actionlint/gitleaks pins in .githooks/pins.ps1

assertions.name: mentions SDK target consideration
assertions.description: Response mentions that an SDK BuildTools bump may require TargetFramework or MaxVersionTested updates

assertions.name: includes build validation
assertions.description: Response includes a dotnet build validation step

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing the app's own release version
